source_components.vertical_processing: building local Y = source orthometric height minus common 32.0 m datum; zero-height source road vertices draped to the cropped source TIN with +0.02 m display offset; cameras interpolate the TIN
source_components.road_elevation_limitations: All selected source LOD1 road heights are 0.0 and are treated as missing elevations. Only road vertices are draped to the DEM; triangulated polygon interiors are an approximation, not a terrain-clipped road surface.
source_components.scope: Modern source buildings, roads and terrain; not a single-date view of the current city or evidence of 1976 conditions.

survey_year_encoding.note: Tokyo product specification: Gregorian year as four digits; unknown is 0001. Do not interpret 0001 as a known survey year.

source_temporality.note: Release year, feature creation date and survey year are distinct. Per-feature survey years are retained; an unknown year is null.

processing: scripts/render_blockout.py compares archived E/F previews from the prior flat-ground geometry and prior camera positions with the revised terrain-aware layout and revised camera positions; both geometry and camera placement change, so this is not an isolated camera-only comparison; rasterizes geometry with study materials, draws labels and includes source/uncertainty notices. No archival photograph raster or generated colour master is used as a texture.
coordinate_system: Local right-handed east/up/south, metres; JGD2011 origin latitude 35.6945, longitude 139.702; Building/terrain Y = source orthometric height minus 32 m. Source road heights are all zero and treated as missing; road vertices use interpolated terrain Y + 0.02 m, with approximate triangulated interiors. Horizontal projection: GRS80 ECEF to local tangent east/north, Z = -north.
inferred_elements: Manual roof/plaza interpretation from approximately 1 m/pixel historical aerial imagery, uncertain capture date and approximate map-datum alignment. Proxy heights, plaza boundary, historical layout exclusions and camera placements are explicit hypotheses, not surveyed 1976 dimensions. The northern theatre identity, actual theatre entrance/façade axis and gate chronology remain unresolved. Modern reference only. A shared orthometric datum preserves source relative elevations; the terrain is a modern source TIN, not a surveyed 1976 surface. All 176 selected LOD1 source roads have zero heights, interpreted as missing elevation. Road vertices are draped to the source TIN with a +0.02 m display offset; linearly triangulated polygon interiors are approximate and are not clipped to the TIN. Building survey years differ or are unknown. Context building identities, historic appearance and circa 1976 street levels are unverified.
redistribution_review: PLATEAU source archive README offers CC BY 4.0, selected for the source data. GSI gazo1 is listed under attribution-only non-basic-survey tiles; GSI PDL 1.0 permits CC BY 4.0 use, which is selected here. This artifact contains no redistributed archival photographs or raw aerial raster imagery. The 1975 plaza photograph is cited as evidence only; its redistribution permission and license remain unconfirmed.

comparison_scope.before: Archived E/F rasters from the specified prior commit, using the previous flat-ground geometry and previous camera positions.
comparison_scope.after: Current E/F rasters, using the revised common-datum terrain-aware geometry, explicit layout exclusions and revised camera positions.
comparison_scope.limitation: The image compares revisions; it does not isolate the effect of camera placement from terrain/layout changes.
